question: As a last resort, who decides whether to redraw price areas if the countries involved cannot agree unanimously?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 14(8) of Regulation 2019/943 states that if the relevant Member States fail to reach a unanimous decision within six months, the Commission, after consulting ACER, adopts a decision as a measure of last resort whether to amend or maintain the bidding zone configuration.", "other_articles": [{"doc_id": "reg_2019_943_art15", "answers": "fully", "why": "Article 15(5) states that when the relevant Member States cannot decide unanimously, the Commission, as a last resort and after consulting ACER and stakeholders, decides whether to amend or maintain the bidding zone configuration."}], "ambiguity": "minor", "ambiguity_reason": "The question does not say whether it concerns the Article 14 review route or the Article 15 action-plan route. Both give the same answer: the Commission.", "suggested_fix": "Accept both reg_2019_943_art14 and reg_2019_943_art15 as gold, or specify the context (the bidding zone review versus failure to meet the linear trajectory)."}

verdict.gold_reason: Article 14(8) of Regulation 2019/943 states that if the relevant Member States fail to reach a unanimous decision within six months, the Commission, after consulting ACER, adopts a decision as a measure of last resort whether to amend or maintain the bidding zone configuration.

other_articles.why: Article 15(5) states that when the relevant Member States cannot decide unanimously, the Commission, as a last resort and after consulting ACER and stakeholders, decides whether to amend or maintain the bidding zone configuration.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question does not say whether it concerns the Article 14 review route or the Article 15 action-plan route. Both give the same answer: the Commission.
verdict.suggested_fix: Accept both reg_2019_943_art14 and reg_2019_943_art15 as gold, or specify the context (the bidding zone review versus failure to meet the linear trajectory).
